channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 18
item.description:
90 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Adjusted river terrain generation to prevent cliffs from raising terrain over river beds, resulting in smoother rivers.
  • Added new stash filters (ammo, food, tools, building, etc.) and made extraction jobs stay locked until completed, granting recipes from hand‑ins.
  • Fixed a small terrain gap at river source rocks and water pipe decor, preventing players from falling through or seeing missing terrain.
  • Removed stray first‑person elements that appeared in the shoulder camera view.

Weapon Systems

  • Fixed server null reference error that could cause SpinUpWeapon to malfunction, improving weapon reliability.
  • Fixed multiple third‑person gun attachment issues, including barrel alignment and silencer muzzle offsets, ensuring attachments behave correctly.

Player Spawn & Item Placement

  • Prevented new players from spawning underwater, fixing a game‑breaking spawn location bug.
  • Improved placement reliability for deployable items such as bags and towels by increasing deployment bounds.

NPC & AI

  • Fixed travelling vendor spawn failures, ensuring vendors appear consistently without server restarts.
  • Corrected the wolf's initial idle animation, improving its behavior when first encountered.

Map & UI

  • Added dynamic monument map markers that can change label text and position at runtime, improving map navigation.

World Generation

  • Adjusted river terrain generation to prevent cliffs from raising terrain over river beds, resulting in smoother rivers.

Extraction System

  • Added new stash filters (ammo, food, tools, building, etc.) and made extraction jobs stay locked until completed, granting recipes from hand‑ins.

World & Terrain

  • Fixed a small terrain gap at river source rocks and water pipe decor, preventing players from falling through or seeing missing terrain.

Camera & View

  • Removed stray first‑person elements that appeared in the shoulder camera view.

Clothing & Sleep

  • Reverted a previous fix, so sleeping cloth may again clip into the player’s body during sleep animations.

Customization (Tattoos)

  • Tattoo stencil size now matches screen space, fixing mismatched head/body stamp sizes.
  • Tattoo brush now uses proper sampling, eliminating pixelated brush marks.

Settings UI

  • Color dropdowns in settings now close correctly after selection.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 17
item.description:
122 development commits

Inventory & Crafting

  • Backpack items are now included in all inventory searches and item transfers, streamlining crafting and item management.
  • Supplier missions, in‑raid crafting lists, and shop listings have been fixed, ensuring reliable mission rewards and crafting options.
  • Contraband loot tier has been rebalanced for a more consistent reward curve.

Vehicles & World Interaction

  • 2‑module car prefabs now have correct IDs, eliminating errors when deploying those vehicles.
  • A crash caused by loading a vine that had already finished swinging has been resolved, improving overall stability.
  • Cobalt tattoo stencil pack now unlocks its stencils directly via the Steam item, making the new designs immediately usable.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Watercatcher and chicken coop loot panels now automatically select the bucket when it’s in the belt, and disabled blueprints display a clear “cannot learn” tooltip.
  • Sleeping bag respawns no longer trap players in tight spaces, and respawning on a bag now requires clicking the bag, preventing accidental stuck situations.

Extraction Hub Overhaul

  • Loot reveal order at extraction now shows forward items first and the best last, with adjusted reveal range for smoother looting.
  • Extraction balloons are now indestructible, ensuring they remain functional throughout the extraction phase.
  • New balloon doors, Burn & Extract mechanic, hub sounds, and balloon platforms with consoles and sirens have been added to the extraction hub, expanding interactive elements.
  • Bandit patrols cover a wider area, guards will search for lost players, and a door‑unlock cue has been added for clearer navigation.
  • Hidden shop unlocks, a hub radio, and a fixed shop scroll UI enhance the outpost’s commerce experience.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Turn‑in‑place animation no longer restarts when equipping items mid‑turn.
  • Sleeping bags no longer get stuck on respawn, ensuring proper placement.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 16
item.description:
323 development commits

Extraction Raid Mode

  • Introduced a new extraction raid mode featuring a 3km procedural map, hot-air balloon extraction points with countdown timers, and a dedicated Outpost hub for loot stashing and unlocks.
  • Implemented a new Outpost hub system with a supplies shop, automatic healing, and incremental upgrades for furnaces and ovens using wood, stone, and metal.
  • Added synchronized squad deployment via team leaders and a raid summary page to review outcomes after extraction.

Combat & AI

  • Introduced Scout Drones that patrol monuments, emit search lights, and can call guards to investigate players.
  • Updated AI behavior: Bandits now use Generation 2 AI and attack walls; monument guards are now tiered by strength with realistic detection delays.
  • Added a new Bradley APC boss mission at an abandoned military base and a Water Treatment Plant raid unlocked after completing Oxum's base.

Items & Economy

  • Overhauled inventory with a new 'Safe Pocket' system, scrap value displays for loot, and backpack-dependent inventory sizes.
  • Expanded the stash system with purchasable rows (up to 4 additional) and new filters for easier management.
  • Balance updates: Increased bow damage, added new rocket launcher recipes, and introduced wood armor sleeves.

World & Mechanics

  • Implemented a depth-based Fog of War effect and added a new island map based on Hapis Island terrain.
  • Added the ability to demolish rooms and remove kits by holding the action button.
  • Introduced a server-enabled shoulder camera with free-look, sliding while sprinting, and a third-person chase camera for vehicles.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Guard and scout health increased, making them tougher.
  • Oxum's bandits now deal 3-5 damage, preventing one-shot kills.

World & Map Fixes

  • Train tunnel entrances, station connections, and ramp network issues fixed to prevent void spawns.
  • Monument ladders extended for higher access.
  • Catapult off-map clipping bug fixed.
  • Building block invisibility bug fixed.
  • CH47 crate now lands correctly on powerline poles.

Base Building & Tools

  • Door controllers remain paired after door reskin.

Missions & Interactions

  • Hold-E mission interactions now lock movement/camera, require full progress, and preserve safe-pocket items.

Combat & NPC

  • Third-person attack alignment corrected.
  • Turn-in-place rotation pop fix in first-person view.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Tooltips no longer offset based on FPS.
  • Settings dropdowns stay closed after selection.
  • Recycle Bin upgrade drag now swaps items correctly.
